text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the Fan Appreciation 
Festival. Ball games, performances... each 
Umamusume had different preferences for 
what to join, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna do nothin'.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm too busy with races right now. 
Intense ball games are tough, and I 
already hype up fans all the time anyway.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do as little as possible. Come up 
with something easy for me, partner.

Even so, skipping out wasn't an option. 
And so, what Jungle Pocket decided to do 
was—
Vintage Clothing: Jungle Gym

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...'Elcome.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...I did that.

A secondhand clothing store lacking any 
motivation. The staff didn't seem 
particularly eager to serve customers 
either...

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text: Um, do you have this in size L?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing.

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's piled high... I wonder if I can 
grab the one at the bottom.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah, don't touch that. It's gonna collapse.
choice_data_list: Try to be a little friendlier...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. This is what my shop's flavor 
is all about.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Only the folks who like this kind of vibe 
need to bother coming."

"It's turned into quite the underground 
shop. I wonder if anyone will actually 
show up."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...'Elcome.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Thanks.

The one who entered was Gold City. Known 
as a once-in-a-century beauty who also 
works as a model, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so the stock they carry is from the 
'70s and '80s...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh... Wait, this selection...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this incredible? Deadstock denim 
like this... where did they even find 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this biker jacket has such nice 
aging... And it's super cheap, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Pokke. Were you always into vintage 
clothes?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No? I just wandered around and bought 
whatever caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And with this selection... It's kind of 
getting out of hand, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you're free, tell me about it. 
Which shops did you check out around here?

I chat with Gold City for a while as she 
shows keen interest. A few more customers 
trickle in after that, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"No, really, that's why I think about it. 
Why is it that only kids can order the 
kids' meal, anyway?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
At least give me a flag, a flag! I kinda 
just wanna stick it into something, ya 
know?

text_block_list.name: Bald Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haha, Pokke, you're such a kid. Who gives 
a crap about that?

Without any real motivation, time just 
slipped away chatting with acquaintances. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is it almost closing time? Partner, 
how much did we sell?
choice_data_list:
Counting Gold City's share, that's an 
extra 2nd and 3rd place...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What the? Hardly any of 'em sold. But...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, it was fun, so whatever. Nothing 
beats shooting the breeze with your pals 
at an event!

And so, Jungle Pocket enjoyed herself in 
her own way.
(*Chatter, chatter, buzz, buzz...*)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what's going on? We didn't 
even advertise, but it's getting crazy 
crowded.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
This is it, right? Jungle Pocket's shop. 
Whoa, it's Jungle Pocket!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I should buy something on the way 
back! Feels like I can win at the critical 
moment, after all.

It seems a lot of fans showed up, drawn by 
Jungle Pocket's popularity.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't this bad? At this rate, the 
shop's gonna get super crowded, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Partner, traffic control! Set up a 
barricade outside the shop and manage the 
crowd!"
(Murmur, murmur, murmur...)

Distributing numbered tickets and having 
them line up. Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't buy 'em all. Limit one per 
customer. Electronic money? Don't take it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, pins are at the register. Autographs? 
Later. Don't push, don't push—if you push, 
I'll clobber ya!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaa♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why are you getting so hyped up!?

—And just like that, the shop was a huge 
success.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Phew, nice work, partner. We totally 
winged that shop, but it ended up being 
super popular.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's almost completely sold out!
Yeah, they're almost completely sold out!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is that one leather jacket 
over there, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm, that... Hey, you try putting it on.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, something just clicked. Go on, try 
it on.

Following her advice, I slipped it on over 
my shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, looking cool! It really suits you, 
seriously!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Here, take this as your reward. Honestly, 
I think I just bought it 'cause it 
naturally felt like something that'd suit 
you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Wear it to the races next time. We can 
look like a legit street-racer crew 
together."

The visit to the shop was a huge success. 
Seeing herself in the leather jacket put 
Jungle Pocket in the best mood ever.
